name: Surfer SEO
tagline: Surfer SEO is a content optimisation platform that analyses the top-ranking pages for a keyword and gives writers a real-time content score showing how well their draft covers the topic. Its AI outline and article generation tools build a fully structured, SEO-optimised draft from scratch in seconds. Content teams at agencies and in-house SEO departments use Surfer to produce content that reliably ranks.
